name: Arthur Penhaligon
psychographics: Values practicality and financial security over trends; enjoys routine and tangible results.
current_solutions: Manages finances via Lloyds Bank online banking; shops weekly at Waitrose; uses a Kindle Paperwhite for reading.
frustration: Forgot his Lloyds Bank PIN while trying to pay a bill at 9:15 AM on a Tuesday, locking the account for 20 minutes.
decision_style: Compares features in-store for major purchases; reads Which? reviews religiously before buying appliances.
voice: Rambling but polite; often starts sentences with 'Well, to be fair...' and circles back to the main point.
